name: singlet_ambient_contamination_fraction
title: Estimate ambient contamination fraction
description: Estimates the fraction of each cell barcode's UMIs that is ambient (cell-free) RNA, plus a per-sample summary with a plausibility flag. The default method decontx needs only layers/counts; soupx needs cluster_key and raw/counts; cellbender and scar need raw/counts and may run as queued jobs. Writes obs/ambient_frac_<method>, uns/ambient_summary_<method> and, for cellbender and scar, model weights; it never changes counts. Do not use it to remove counts (use ambient.count_removal) or with soupx, cellbender or scar on data without empty barcodes.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: .singlet path, URI (s3://, r2://, https://) or workspace handle. Needs layers/counts; raw/counts for soupx, cellbender, scar.

method.description: decontx (default, per cell), soupx (per sample, needs cluster_key), cellbender (deep model, includes barcode swapping), scar (deep model, fixed ambient profile).

cluster_key.description: obs column with cluster labels. Required for soupx, optional for decontx (otherwise clustered internally), ignored by cellbender and scar.

sample_key.description: obs column identifying the channel or sample; estimation and the per-sample summary are grouped by it.

seed.description: Random seed for decontx initialisation, cellbender and scar. Ignored by soupx, which is deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA for cellbender and scar training when a device with enough memory is available, otherwise CPU.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing ambient_frac and ambient_summary members of the same method instead of failing.

soupx.description: Options used only when method is soupx.

contamination_range.description: Lower and upper bound of the channel estimate; the upper bound also sets the non-expression test.

tfidf_min.description: Minimum tf-idf for a marker gene.

soup_quantile.description: Soup abundance quantile above which genes become marker candidates.

max_markers.description: Maximum number of marker genes used.

non_expression_fdr.description: False discovery rate of the test that excludes clusters expressing a marker.

prior_rho.description: Prior mode of the contamination fraction.

prior_rho_sd.description: Prior standard deviation of the contamination fraction; the Gamma shape is moment-matched to it.

force_accept.description: Accept channel estimates above 0.5 instead of returning an error.

decontx.description: Options used only when method is decontx.

delta.description: Dirichlet pseudo-counts for native and contamination counts; initial values when estimate_delta is true.

estimate_delta.description: Refit the pseudo-counts from the barcodes at every EM iteration.

convergence.description: Stop when the largest change in any barcode's native share falls below this.

use_empty_droplets.description: Use the empty-droplet profile from raw/counts as the contamination profile instead of one built from other clusters.

cellbender.description: Options used only when method is cellbender.

model.description: full models ambient RNA and barcode swapping; ambient models ambient RNA only.

fpr.description: Target false positive rate: share of true signal counts removed; the reported fraction grows with it.

learning_rate.description: Base learning rate under a OneCycle schedule whose peak is ten times larger.

low_count_threshold.description: Barcodes with fewer UMIs are excluded from the analysis.

expected_cells.description: Expected number of cells, within a factor of 2; null uses CellBender's heuristic prior. Recommended.

scar.description: Options used only when method is scar.

ambient_prob.description: Probability cut that selects cell-free droplets for the ambient profile; at least 50 droplets must pass.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/ambient_frac_decontx and uns/ambient_summary_decontx. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs only: method, sample_key and per_sample entries (sample, n_cells, median, mean, iqr, frac_above_0.1, frac_above_0.3, flag). The flag is ok, warning (sample median above 0.3) or failure (above 0.5). soupx adds the channel estimate and bounds. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
